description: Outcome of a TmUserPicker search or resolve fetch. Callers must distinguish Empty (the fetch succeeded and found nothing) from Transient (the fetch itself failed, e.g. a network blip); conflating the two hides real outages behind a silent "no results" message.

members.name: Empty
members.description: The fetch succeeded but found no matching items.

members.name: Transient
members.description: The fetch failed for a reason that may resolve on retry (timeout, network error, 5xx, and similar).
